name: Delivering Daffodils
summary: Delivering Daffodils concludes a small domestic errand running between the guard post and town square in Lakeshire. After fetching lunch for Guard Parker and picking up a bouquet from herbalist Martie Jainrose, you hand over the blooms to Darcy at the Lakeshire Inn, only to stumble straight into an awkward local rivalry.

sections.title: A Fragrant Errand
sections.body: What began as a simple favor delivering a hot meal to Guard Parker turns into a delicate romantic gesture. Grateful for his lunch, Parker asks you to fetch flowers from Martie Jainrose as a surprise for Darcy, the cook who prepared his food. Martie arranges a fresh bouquet of her own favorite blooms—daffodils—unaware of who is intended to receive them.

sections.title: Town Rivalries
sections.body: Upon bringing the bouquet back to the Lakeshire Inn, Darcy's initial delight quickly curdles into suspicion. Recognizing daffodils as Martie's personal favorite, Darcy immediately suspects Parker dealt with a woman she considers a jealous vixen. While worried Martie might have spitefully poisoned the stems had she known the recipient, Darcy relieves you of blame and hands over a hot portion of sauteed sunfish for your trouble.

faq.answer: Darcy works at the Lakeshire Inn in Redridge Mountains, preparing meals for locals and town guards. She is the cook who sent a lunch to Guard Parker, prompting Parker to send back a bouquet of flowers in gratitude.

Martie Jainrose is Lakeshire's resident herbalist and flower enthusiast. Guard Parker directs you to her to purchase a nice bouquet, and Martie happily assembles daffodils, noting they happen to be her own favorite flowers.

faq.q: Why is Darcy upset about the daffodils?
faq.answer: Darcy instantly recognizes daffodils as Martie's favorite flower. She considers Martie a jealous rival and fears Martie would have poisoned the stems had she known the bouquet was meant for Darcy.

faq.q: Did Martie actually poison the bouquet?
faq.answer: No. Martie had no idea the flowers were intended for Darcy, as Parker simply asked you to pick up an arrangement, and Martie casually chose her own favorites for the bundle.

faq.q: What quests lead up to this delivery?
faq.answer: The chain starts with 'A Free Lunch', where you carry Darcy's meal to Guard Parker. Parker then gives you 'Visit the Herbalist' to buy a gift from Martie Jainrose, which ends with 'Delivering Daffodils'.

faq.q: What reward do you get for delivering the flowers?
faq.answer: Darcy thanks you with a hearty bundle of sauteed sunfish, some copper and experience, along with standing with the kingdom of Stormwind.

angles.text: Darcy rewards your delivery with seasoned sauteed sunfish, offering an example of simple Redridge lakeside home cooking.
The errand relies on Martie Jainrose's botanical knowledge and her eye for fresh lakeside blooms, showcasing the peaceful side of herb gathering.
Assisting the town guard and innkeeper in Lakeshire helps maintain civilian morale while the town struggles under Blackrock and gnoll incursions.
